# Rule 1 - Don't be a Dick:
Some common sense, but some guidelines to follow:
\n
- Don't make the game worse for others.
- Roleplay is collaborative. Fight other characters, not their players.
- Harassment and bigotry are strictly prohibited.
- No slurs, no bullying, no fishing for reactions though "jokes".
- Antagonists are part of the story too, not a target or speed bump in it.
- Think of the outcome of your actions. If you find yourself making excuses for your behavior, you've likely crossed the line.
- We can forgive mistakes not patterns.
- Do not push politics into the game
- Do not greif, harass, or invalidate other players time.
- Do not seek to evade IC consequences, via starting private scenes or ending your session without pulling an admin in to inform others on your behalf.
